teacher_insights.title: Learning Gaps & Performance Insights
teacher_insights.subtitle: Evidence-based learning gap analysis, salt performance, practical mistakes, and student support recommendations.
teacher_insights.topics_section_desc: Evaluates student accuracy across chemistry concepts from graded quizzes. Formula: Gap Score = 1 - (Correct / Total). Topics require at least 10 valid answers to qualify as confirmed evidence.
teacher_insights.topics_empty: No graded quiz answers recorded yet for this class.
teacher_insights.salts_section_desc: Detailed theory quiz and practical completion breakdown for each salt in the curriculum.
teacher_insights.mistakes_section_desc: Frequencies of procedural errors detected from verified Unity lab result tokens.
teacher_insights.no_telemetry_desc: Students in this class have not redeemed any practical tokens with lab telemetry. Offline practical runs without tokens cannot be tracked.
teacher_insights.support_section_title: Students Who May Benefit from Support
teacher_insights.support_section_desc: Transparent, evidence-based recommendations based on low quiz scores, repeated mistakes, or recent inactivity.
teacher_insights.support_empty: No students currently flagged. All active students are performing above support thresholds.
teacher_insights.data_notice_text: Insights are calculated strictly from recorded database submissions and verified tokens. No hypothetical performance is inferred when data is absent.

teacher_exports.section_subtitle: Export academic records and analytics to spreadsheets. All exports are encoded in UTF-8 with formula injection protection.

teacher_exports.practicals_desc: Laboratory redemption entries, completion status, lab-token validity, recorded mistake categories, and durations.
